about.title: From code to server, I close the loop.
paragraphs: I'm a computer scientist and I've been doing full-stack development for over {{years}} years. I started as an intern, was promoted to junior developer in three months and, since 2022, I've designed, built and maintained platforms for medical institutions such as SBU-SP, SBN and UNIFESP: e-learning, membership management, recurring billing, events and nationwide health campaigns, used by thousands of professionals.

In 2026 I joined Mais Envios to work on high-volume logistics integrations: microservices, messaging and observability with NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ. In parallel, I remain responsible for the architecture and operation of more than {{services}} services in production.
I don't stop at shipping code. I handle the deploy, the server, the monitoring and whatever comes after, because a good system is one that keeps working.

pillars.title: Full-stack product
pillars.text: Complete platforms, from database to interface: Node.js, NestJS, Vue, React and Next.js. Multi-tenant SaaS or a dedicated instance, depending on the case.

pillars.title: Integrations and messaging
pillars.text: Payments, logistics, marketplaces and third-party APIs (Mercado Pago, Google, Meta, Zoom, OpenAI). Queues, safe retries and clear contracts for what can't fail silently.

pillars.title: Applied AI
pillars.text: Agents and automations that plug into the real flow of the product and the team. And AI as part of my own engineering process, with rules and review.

pillars.title: Infra and operations
pillars.text: Linux servers, Nginx, PM2, Docker, CI/CD and observability. I keep what I build running.

work.title: Tools change. Judgment doesn't.
work.intro: The way software gets built has changed a lot in the past year. Today I run several projects in parallel with AI agents, but I'm the one who decides the architecture, sets the limits and answers for the result.

items.title: Context before code
items.text: Every project has its rules, inventory and runbooks written down. That's what lets an agent, or a new teammate, work safely.

items.title: Agents with guardrails
items.text: Production is read-only by default. Server changes need explicit approval. Clear limits are worth more than clever prompts.

items.title: Review is non-negotiable
items.text: AI writes fast; I read everything. Nothing reaches production before I understand what changed and why.

items.title: Verify before claiming
items.text: Tests, logs and metrics before saying it's done. Optimism isn't evidence.

team.title: On a team
team.intro: I don't arrive wanting to change everything. I arrive to understand, then I take on what's stuck.

steps.title: First, I learn
steps.text: I come in to understand the company's rules, the context and the reasons behind decisions already made.

steps.title: Then, I find the bottleneck
steps.text: Where the team loses time, where risk piles up, what nobody has time to look at.

steps.title: Then, I take the lead
steps.text: I propose, deliver and document, respecting leadership and aligning before changing what belongs to everyone.

items.title: Full-Stack Developer / Logistics Integrations Engineer
items.summary: Systems for high-volume logistics operations, focused on reliability, integrations and automation.
highlights: Microservices and integrations with carriers, marketplaces and e-commerce platforms, with clear contracts and safe retries.
Event-driven architecture with messaging and asynchronous processing to absorb traffic spikes without degrading operations.
End-to-end traceability and observability (metrics and correlated logs) to shorten incident diagnosis.
Automations and guardrails that cut manual rework and silent failures in third-party integrations.

items.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer / AI Solutions Engineer
items.summary: Architecture, development and operation of the platforms used by national and international medical societies.
highlights: Medical e-learning platform with progress tracking and engagement analytics, which increased course completion rates.
World Kidney Day platform, connecting hospitals nationwide in prevention campaigns.
Geolocation-based specialist search, with accurate results close to the user.
Annual fee and recurring subscription management integrated with Mercado Pago, reducing delinquency.
Administration of the production servers: deploys, Nginx, PM2, security updates and monitoring.
AI integrations and automations to optimize workflows and scale the systems.

items.title: Junior Developer
items.summary: Promoted from intern to junior developer in three months, for technical performance and initiative.
highlights: Integrations with Google, Facebook (OAuth 2.0) and Mercado Pago.
Modeling and optimization of relational databases.
